paragraphs: Mobile security isn't an afterthought in my architecture — it's the foundation. Over 16+ years, I've built enterprise mobile platforms where OWASP Mobile Top 10 compliance, attestation, and tamper resistance are designed in from day one, backed by TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner certification and target-state architectural rigor.

At Everi India, I own the mobile security governance framework protecting transactional features like Digital Wallet and Room Access: dynamic SSL/TLS pinning, Firebase App Check, and Play Integrity/App Attest verification, backed by automated application shielding through OneSpan and AppDome — enforced across a white-labeled Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) and Ionic-Angular platform serving Gaming, Sports, Venues, and Loyalty clients from a single codebase. I drive that architecture and security standard across multiple agile delivery teams, authoring Architecture Decision Records that reduce onboarding time and technical debt.

Earlier, at Adeptech Systems, I led secure fintech payment development — Mobile POS and Digital Wallet modules — while personally resolving findings from Application Security Assessments and guiding a team of 15 engineers as technical lead. I use MobSF, Burp Suite, ZAP, and ImmuniWeb as working tools, not resume keywords, and hold a Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) credential to back the practice with formal rigor across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.

caseStudies.title: White-Labeled Mobile Platform for Multi-Vertical Delivery
caseStudies.problem: Multiple business lines (Gaming, Sports, Venues, Loyalty) needed distinct branded apps without maintaining separate codebases for each client.
caseStudies.role: Lead Software Engineer I — Mobile Solution Architecture, owning cross-platform architecture strategy end-to-end.
caseStudies.approach: Architected a configurable, white-labeled platform using MVVM and Clean Architecture to decouple business logic from UI, enabling SDK-style customization from a single maintained codebase. Paired this with automated CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) embedding security gates (Checkmarx, SonarQube) for policy enforcement and white-label app generation.
caseStudies.outcome: Consistent design patterns and technical standards adopted across multiple agile delivery teams; deployment time reduced.
caseStudies.outcomeFlag: Resume states "cutting deployment time" without a percentage — add a specific figure if available.

caseStudies.title: OWASP-Aligned Mobile Security Framework
caseStudies.problem: Transactional mobile features (Digital Wallet, Room Access, Food Ordering) needed defense against reverse engineering, MITM attacks, and app tampering across a white-label platform serving multiple clients.
caseStudies.role: Designed and enforced the mobile security governance framework.
caseStudies.approach: Implemented dynamic SSL pinning, Firebase App Check, and automated application shielding (OneSpan/AppDome), all aligned to OWASP Mobile Top 10 standards.
caseStudies.outcome: A repeatable security baseline enforced across the shared platform rather than per-client rework.
caseStudies.outcomeFlag: No quantified metric (e.g., vulnerabilities blocked, audit pass rate, incident reduction) is given — add one if available.

caseStudies.title: Metadata-Driven Native UI Framework
caseStudies.problem: New feature development for warranty-management workflows was slow because UI had to be hand-built for each enterprise client.
caseStudies.role: Technical Lead — Mobile Platform Architecture, leading a cross-functional team of 8 engineers.
caseStudies.approach: Designed a cloud-native "Write Once, Configure Anywhere" framework that rendered native UI components from configurable metadata, combined with a data-synchronization strategy using RESTful APIs and intelligent local caching.
caseStudies.outcome: Cut new feature development time by 70% and boosted application throughput by 40% during peak traffic.

caseStudies.title: Secure Fintech Payment Platform
caseStudies.problem: Enterprise fintech clients needed real-time, secure payment capture on Android devices, integrating third-party hardware for card swiping and tax payments.
caseStudies.role: Senior Android Developer and technical lead/SPOC, guiding a team of 15 engineers.
caseStudies.approach: Led end-to-end development of Mobile POS and Official Payments solutions, integrating external hardware SDKs (MagTek, IDTECH); implemented Digital Wallet and transaction-management modules while participating in Application Security Assessments and resolving vulnerability findings.
caseStudies.outcome: Delivered partial refunds, void transactions, and payment history reporting features into production.
